info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to protect,to watch,to take care of

examples: 'saMrakzAmi vilumpAmi dadAmyahamaTAdade' (BA॰SAM॰224.43). saMrakzAmi=samyag rakzAmi. vilumpAmi=viSezeRa Cinadmi.
'BagavaYCrotumicCAvo yasmin kAle niSAcarO. saMrakzaRIyO tO brUhi nAtivarteta tatkzaRam' (rA॰1.30.2).. saMrakzaraRIyO yajYasaMrakzaRAya nivAraRIyO.
'A mA mitrAvaruReha rakzatam' (f0 7.50.1). A samantAd rakzataM gopAyatam.
'tasya dvArARi sarvARi paryAptAni bfhanti ca.… yantrErArakzitAni ca' (BA0 ASrama0 5.17).
'AviSyemAM DaraRIM ye'Byarakzan purAtanIM tasya devasya sfzwim' (BA0 anu0 18.78). uktacara evArTaH.
'agneranIkamapa AviveSApAMnapAt pratirakzannasuryam' (vA0 saM0 8.24). asUryamasurasya mAyAdikaM pratirakzan nivartayan. AtmAnaM rakzanniti tu SabdArTaH.
'jiGatsuBya imaM me parirakzata' (aTarva0 8.2.20). parirakzata parito rakzata.
'na hyeza rAGavasyArTe jIvitaM parirakzati' (rA0 6.4.27). na jIvitaM parirakzati prARavyayaM na gaRayati. jIvitaSezaM nAdriyate.
sajjanaM tUparakzaRam ityamaraH. sEnyasya praguRIkaraRaM gulmako veti svAmI. sEnyarakzaRAya praharikAdernyAsa uparakzaRamiti BAnujiH.
